build_tts_pipeline: build a TextToSpeechPipeline that loads a Tacotron2 or FastSpeech2 model with a HiFiGAN vocoder from a model ID
run_tts_synthesis: run the TextToSpeechPipeline with input text to generate a raw audio waveform and sampling rate
review_tts_init: review the TextToSpeechPipeline initialization to understand how it selects Tacotron2 or FastSpeech2 models
test_tts_call: test the TextToSpeechPipeline call method with sample text to verify waveform output
refactor_tts_vocoder: refactor the TextToSpeechPipeline to support additional vocoder types beyond HiFiGAN
